descriptions.value:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with local access to the affected host could obtain a live Splunk SOAR session token or decrypted asset configuration when another user starts an App Editor debug action.
The vulnerability is possible because App Editor debug actions expose sensitive runtime information to other local users on the affected host.

descriptions.description: A process is invoked with sensitive command-line arguments, environment variables, or other elements that can be seen by other processes on the operating system.

assertions.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure through App Editor Debug Actions in Splunk SOAR

title: Sensitive Information Disclosure through App Editor Debug Actions in Splunk SOAR
